756650101.text: Hello! Welcome to the "Saurian Expedition Supply Station."

756650102.text: Wow, there are many little saurians here! Are you all going out to look for Ocean Zephyrs?

756650103.text: Time and tide wait for no man. The Ocean Zephyr-picking squad's already left.

756650104.text: Though these young'uns want to help, no matter how hard Mr. Ifa and Mr. Cacucu try to teach them, they don't quite get what an Ocean Zephyr is.

756650105.text: To honor their enthusiasm, Mr. Ifa let them join the expedition... Although what counts as an "expedition" was left up to them.

756650106.text: Whether it's yummy Grainfruit or shiny trinkets, they can collect whatever they want. All that matters is that they get back safely.

756650107.text: Paimon gets it... Well, they sure look happy. Stay safe, little ones! The outside world's full of bad guys!

756650109.text: We're here to guide the little saurians along on their expedition. If you're interested, you can come check it out.
